Historical full-card image of [[R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo) (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Remastered 2006)|R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo)]], matching the [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
